briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.title: Michigan Cracks $17B in Sales as Psychedelics Sprint Toward FDA Approval
briefs.top: Michigan's legal cannabis market just topped $17 billion in lifetime sales and the state's biggest trade group is now backing a gubernatorial candidate who's promised to kill the 24% wholesale tax. Nationally, momentum is building fast — courts just upheld medical marijuana's Schedule III status, Compass Pathways' psilocybin therapy is closing in on FDA approval, and MSOs are raising cash and striking deals at a pace not seen in years.
